The implementation is complete and thoroughly validated. Summary of what was delivered:

## `/workspace/submission/main.py` (single self-contained file, 24.8 KB, stdlib only)

**I/O driver** â reads all of stdin, splits into physical lines (bytes before LF, CR preserved), writes exactly one compact JSON object + newline per line, exits 0. Empty stream â no output; processing continues after bad lines.

**Validation pipeline** (stages in contract order):
1. line > 1,048,576 bytes â `E_LIMIT`; strict UTF-8 decode â `E_JSON`
2. regex-assisted nesting scan (strings/escapes as JSON does, depth floored at 0, cap 64) â `E_LIMIT`, applied even to malformed text
3. `json.loads` with `parse_constant` rejecting `NaN`/`Infinity` and an `object_pairs_hook` rejecting duplicate keys â `E_JSON`
4. whole-document lone-surrogate scan + exact-key schema validation (expression forms, known service references, distinct/nonempty services) â `E_SCHEMA`
5. all declared size limits (services, rules, 256 nodes, 32 args, 16-token atom paths, 10 distinct atoms, queries) â `E_LIMIT`
6. monitor-product reachability cap of 20,000 distinct tuples â `E_COMPLEXITY` (checked before Boolean simplification, counting atoms even in unreachable branches)

**Compilation** â exact per-atom monitors (`match`/`startswith`/`endswith`/`contains` including empty-pattern cases, failure and absorbing states); synchronous product over referenced atoms after exact constant folding (provably the same minimal DFA); acceptance = â¨allow â§ Â¬â¨drop; **Hopcroft minimization** with a contiguous-range partition and classical fixed-splitter semantics; canonical BFS numbering in declared alphabet order; reverse-BFS viability distances; queries evaluated on the exported DFA.

**Verification** (all green): public examples byte-exact; ~2,000 randomized differential cases vs. an independently written reference (full product, recursive evaluation, Moore refinement) across four generator families including exhaustive word checks up to length 10; 3,000 random dense DFAs for the minimizer vs. pair-BFS equivalence; 4,000 random monitors vs. an independent implementation and direct predicate semantics; 60,000 random texts for the nesting scan; ~120 error/limit/ordering/Unicode-boundary cases; stress runs (8 lines Ã 15.5k-state minimal DFA Ã 24 symbols â 11 s, 81 MB, 15.8 MB output; over-cap detection).
